subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 1 — retire dead keys, dedupe channel schemas, add growth ratchet

question: Should the published `TelegramDmThreadReplies` SDK type be retained as a deprecated type-only alias until a major-version removal, while runtime config rejects the retired key?
rationale: The repository policy treats shipped external Plugin SDK removals as compatibility-sensitive and requires a named deprecation path; the patch can be mechanically repaired, but maintainers own the public contract timing.

options.title: Retain a deprecated type alias
options.body: Keep the type-only export with a deprecation annotation while continuing to reject the retired runtime configuration key.

options.title: Approve a breaking SDK removal
options.body: Accept that external plugins importing the type must change immediately and document the versioned compatibility break.

recommendation.title: Retain a deprecated type alias
recommendation.body: Keep the type-only export with a deprecation annotation while continuing to reject the retired runtime configuration key.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR’s supplied history and stated maintainer-directed config program connect this contributor to the affected config and SDK surface.
